final: WITH g AS (SELECT o.weathprofile AS w, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avgband, COUNT(*) AS n FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON o.observstation = t.observstation WHERE t.detecttempk > 152.1 GROUP BY o.weathprofile) SELECT w AS weathprofile, avgband, n, avgband - (SELECT AVG(avgband) FROM g) AS diff_from_mean FROM g WHERE (SELECT AVG(avgband) FROM g) IS NOT NULL
